from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

img = np.array(Image.open("/work/observations/obs_0044.png").convert("RGB"))

# Let determine current pose after frame 44:
# Frame 42 pose: xc=0.213, yc=4.336, th=225
# Frame 43 action: turn_deg=90 -> th=315 deg, move_m=0.5 -> dx=-0.354, dy=0.354 -> xc=-0.141, yc=4.690
# Frame 44 action: turn_deg=-90 -> th=225 deg, move_m=0.5 -> dx=-0.354, dy=-0.354 -> xc=-0.495, yc=4.336
xc, yc, th = -0.495, 4.336, np.radians(225.0)
f, H = 256.0, 1.55

# Plant pot base:
pot_mask = (img[:, :, 0] > 140) & (img[:, :, 0] < 200) & (img[:, :, 1] > 60) & (img[:, :, 1] < 110) & (img[:, :, 2] < 70)
pts = np.argwhere(pot_mask)
print(f"Pot pixels: {len(pts)}")
min_u, max_u = pts[:, 1].min(), pts[:, 1].max()
max_v = pts[:, 0].max()
center_u = (min_u + max_u) / 2.0
Zc = f * H / (max_v - 256.0)
Xc = (center_u - 256.0) * H / (max_v - 256.0)
Xw = xc + Xc * np.cos(th) + Zc * np.sin(th)
Yw = yc - Xc * np.sin(th) + Zc * np.cos(th)
print(f"Plant: center_u={center_u:.1f}, max_v={max_v} -> Zc={Zc:.3f}, Xc={Xc:.3f} -> World: ({Xw:.3f}, {Yw:.3f})")
'
